acceptanceCriteria: A clean dogfood finish or change that records a diff including .gitignore and a CEM sidecar can subsequently run the unchanged query and dogfood change without unsupported-query-trace-state.
Recorder path admission and query/migration historical admission agree for all emitted rows; invalid records fail with actionable recovery that preserves original bytes.
A regression covers finish then clean change/check/seal on one checkout; no task rewording, trace deletion, or new checkout is needed.
body:
Observed while qualifying issue #323 on bind e0598b8480b1fbb58bcdb3895714dd0fc758b86c. dogfood finish passed and emitted a trace containing .gitignore and .corvint/change.cem.json. The subsequent unchanged make dogfood-change and corvint query refused: changed_paths path was not tracked at trace revision e0598b8480b1fbb58bcdb3895714dd0fc758b86c: .gitignore. git ls-tree confirms that path is tracked. migrate-traces --dry-run refuses the same row. Original trace and receipts retained in /tmp/corvint-opencode-frontier-20260928/issue323-trace-refusal and the opencode-report worktree. The identical bind commit passed change/check/seal in a fresh opencode-evidence worktree. This is separate from OpenCode qualification; no trace or task text was removed or rewritten. Investigate recorder versus historical source-index admission; root cause not yet proved.

2026-09-28 diagnosis: recorder includes tracked root/nested .gitignore, but current-tree query and migration seed authority from index.Sources only; same-tree ancestor fails while different-tree historical path works. Repair is built on codex/trace-path-continuity from 2e281305, with neutral shared path authority (Gate A PASS). Regression-first failures retained. Repaired adapter and compiled finish/query/change/check/seal regressions pass, and unchanged original fixture query/migration preserves every stored trace hash. Independent implementation review and frozen checks are in progress; integration and native completion remain unperformed. Evidence checkpoint: /tmp/corvint-1-0-orchestrator-20260928/checkpoint.json.

Final local checkpoint: sealed commit7193e399c4ae6d9199e239d258edb8a446a0bd01, sourcec954382468590217174c418ef9d4f5fd9ced0297, evidencebind5eede0474f62994231d064c9e658b609b8ac6675. All three frozen selected checks, GateA/GateB independent review, local completion, independent base/tree check and seal PASS. Frontier remains OPEN with unassessed wider-spec obligations and lexical/static advisories. Publication approval is pending; ticket stays OPEN until integration and native completion succeed. No full release gate or promotion claimed.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0458: commit 1b6ac29f; AC1: compiled finish/query/change/check/seal regression and its passing run retained in docs/build-log/2026-09-28-trace-ignore-rule-continuity.md; AC2: recorder/read/migration share tracerepopaths.Paths, with byte-preserving migration tests and recovery guidance; AC3: TestTraceGitignoreFinishThenChangeCheckSeal uses one checkout and unchanged task. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch A) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.
